channel.title: StarDev — licensing guides
channel.description: Practical guides on license key systems, HWID, and self-hosted licensing.

item.title: Sistem lisensi untuk APK dan mod APK
item.description: Cara kerja lisensi untuk mod APK dan APK mandiri: HWID dari ANDROID_ID, cache offline, fail-closed, dan contoh panggilan HTTP. Plus opsi source code siap deploy.

item.title: Jasa pembuatan key system — apa yang dikerjakan
item.description: Jasa pasang sistem lisensi: deploy backend, integrasi ke script/APK/bot, uji verifikasi, dan serah terima. Ruang lingkup, estimasi waktu, dan hal yang tidak dikerjakan.

item.title: Alternatif KeyAuth: kapan pindah, kapan tetap
item.description: Kapan layanan key hosted masih masuk akal, kapan pindah ke sistem sendiri lebih murah, dan apa yang harus disiapkan sebelum migrasi.

item.title: License system for Roblox scripts
item.description: How key + HWID verification works for Roblox scripts, what Roblox allows over HTTP, and how to run the licensing backend yourself.

item.title: APK license system that survives real users
item.description: How to license a mod APK or standalone Android app: stable HWID, offline grace period, fail-closed defaults, and an endpoint contract that stays simple.

item.title: Designing a license key API that does not need rewrites
item.description: Design a license key API that stays stable: verify, admin, and HWID endpoints, error shapes, rate limits, and idempotent key creation.

item.title: HWID licensing, without the fantasy
item.description: What a HWID check can and cannot do, how many devices to allow, when to auto-reset, and how to store device identifiers without collecting more than needed.

item.title: Berapa harga key system sebenarnya
item.description: Rincian biaya key system: layanan hosted, biaya infrastruktur Vercel/Upstash, dan source code sekali bayar. Hitungan untuk 10 dan 100 pembeli.

item.title: Cara jual script Roblox dengan aman
item.description: Alur menjual script Roblox: harga, pengiriman, loader, key system, dan penanganan pembeli yang minta refund atau membagikan ulang.

item.title: Lisensi aplikasi Android untuk developer indie
item.description: Opsi lisensi untuk aplikasi Android: Play Billing, lisensi sendiri dengan key + HWID, atau layanan pihak ketiga. Plus hal yang harus dihindari.

item.title: Selling Roblox scripts without losing the file
item.description: Delivery models for selling Roblox scripts, what a key system actually protects, refund policy that survives abuse, and how to set device limits.

item.title: Software licensing for indie developers
item.description: When indie software needs licensing at all, the three realistic options, hidden costs of each, and a decision checklist before you write a line of code.

item.title: Menjual key system tanpa kacau
item.description: Cara mengelola penjualan key: membuat stok, menentukan masa aktif, mengirim setelah pembayaran, menangani reset perangkat, dan mencatat pembeli.

item.title: Apa isi source code key system
item.description: Rincian isi source code key system: endpoint verifikasi, panel admin, app admin, bot Telegram/Discord, client Luau. Plus kebutuhan Vercel/Upstash dan batasan lisensi.

item.title: Panel key system yang dipakai, bukan dipajang
item.description: Fitur panel admin yang berguna sehari-hari: daftar key, pencarian, blokir perangkat, log keamanan, dan aksi massal. Plus yang sering ada tapi jarang dipakai.

item.title: Running your own key server
item.description: A practical look at running your own key server: endpoints, Redis schema, key rotation, backups, and the failure cases that bite in production.

item.title: Roblox script key system, end to end
item.description: Design a Roblox key system that handles shared keys, session expiry, and revocation without breaking legitimate players.
